quiz.q: Which city was Bruno Mars born in?
quiz.fact: Honolulu, Hawaii, on 8 October 1985.

quiz.q: What is Bruno Mars's birth name?
quiz.fact: His father called him Bruno when he was two.

quiz.q: From the age of four, he performed in Honolulu as which singer?
quiz.fact: As "Little Elvis", with his family's band, and in the 1992 film Honeymoon in Vegas.

quiz.q: What was his debut studio album, in 2010?
quiz.fact: It carried "Just the Way You Are" and "Grenade".

quiz.q: "Locked Out of Heaven" is from which album?
quiz.fact: His second album, from 2012.

quiz.q: Which of his albums won the Grammy for Album of the Year in 2018?
quiz.fact: 24K Magic, at the 60th Grammy Awards.

quiz.q: "Uptown Funk" (2014) is whose single, featuring Bruno Mars?
quiz.fact: It spent 14 weeks at number one in the US.

quiz.q: Silk Sonic is Bruno Mars and who?
quiz.fact: Their "Leave the Door Open" won Record and Song of the Year.

quiz.q: In which year did he first headline the Super Bowl halftime show?
quiz.fact: Super Bowl XLVIII, in February 2014.

quiz.q: "APT." (2024) is his duet with whom?
quiz.fact: Rosé of BLACKPINK. The same year he sang "Die with a Smile" with Lady Gaga.

quiz.q: Which country is Zara Larsson from?
quiz.fact: She grew up in Stockholm.

quiz.q: At 10, Zara won a TV talent show. Which one?
quiz.fact: She won Talang in 2008.

quiz.q: Which song was the official song of UEFA Euro 2016?
quiz.fact: David Guetta featuring Zara Larsson.

quiz.q: Who did Zara team up with on "Symphony"?
quiz.fact: Clean Bandit featuring Zara Larsson, a UK number one in 2017.

quiz.q: Her 2024 album shares its name with a planet. Which one?
quiz.fact: Venus came out in February 2024.

quiz.q: Who sings with Zara on "Never Forget You"?
quiz.fact: MNEK and Zara Larsson, 2015: her first UK top 10, at number 5.

quiz.q: Her first number one in Sweden, in 2013, was which song?
quiz.fact: "Uncover" topped the Swedish chart in February 2013.

quiz.q: What was Zara's first album released around the world, in 2017?
quiz.fact: So Good came out on 17 March 2017.

quiz.q: How high did "Lush Life" climb in the UK singles chart?
quiz.fact: It peaked at number 3 in spring 2016.

quiz.q: Her 2025 album is named after a Swedish summer where the sun never sets. What is it called?
quiz.fact: Midnight Sun came out in September 2025.
